messages:
Rae (People Ops): FYI we're publishing Handbook v2.2 next Thursday. Main items: updated parental leave tables for UK/IE, small tweak to expense caps, and an EU data-processing blurb. Draft here: https://docs.redwood.ai/handbook/v2.2-local
Omar (HR Ops): Are managers required to acknowledge?
Rae (People Ops): Yes  manager e-sign + a short 15-min manager-only walk-through. Sheet for manager list + ack: https://sheets.goo.gl/rwd-v2-acks. Paste your region checklist and mark confirmed after the walk-through.
Fiona (EMEA Partner): I'll validate the UK/IE numbers. For DE/FR we need legal to add the statutory phrasing for the data clause. @Sam can you add that?
Sam (Legal): On it. I'll drop statutory phrasing and a one-line FAQ for expense caps in the doc under section 4.2.
Omar (HR Ops): Scheduling manager walk-throughs: Tue 0800 UTC (EMEA), Wed 1600 UTC (US), Thu 2200 UTC (APAC). Each 15 min + Qs. Recordings uploaded. Use /rsvp in the invite.
Rae (People Ops): Manager checklist (paste into sheet):
```
- Confirm localized policy with regional partner
- Complete e-sign manager ack
- Share recording with direct reports within 48h
- Flag any JD updates needed for hiring ops
```
NotifBot: Auto-update: 7/50 manager acks received, 1 session full, recording link to follow.
Omar (HR Ops): Hiring ops heads: scan active reqs for "parental" or "relocation" and tag me if they reference legacy numbers. We'll hold postings until JDs are updated.
Fiona (EMEA Partner): I'll run a quick sweep of EMEA reqs and tag the owners.
Sam (Legal): I'll finish DE/FR caveats tonight and post in the doc. Leave a note where you want the PDF export.
Rae (People Ops): Thanks all. Final deadline for manager confirms: next Friday 18:00 UTC. If you can't make a live slot, RSVP and we'll assign a recording + 1:1. I'll post a summary to #general 24h prior to publish. :sparkles:
